title: 받아쓰기 7: 짧은 문장 듣고 쓰기
objective: You can write a short sentence you hear with correct spelling, spaces, and particles.
summary: Write short Korean sentences you hear, with correct spelling and spacing.

task.title: Hear, read, and write
task.line: Read each sound in [ ] aloud, then write the sentence with correct spelling and spacing.

letters.sound: Leave a space between words, even when you hear no pause.
letters.as: Like spaces in English: 저는 물을 마셔요.

letters.sound: Particles like 이/가, 을/를, 은/는, 에 join the word before.
letters.as: Like a suffix -s: 물을, never 물 을.

letters.sound: The final consonant moves to the next vowel: 책이 [채기].
letters.as: Like 'an apple' → 'a-napple'. Write 책이, not 채기.

exercises: Write what you hear in correct spelling: ① [오시 커요] ② [소늘 씨서요] ③ [이르믈 써요]
Add spaces between the words: ① 저는커피를마셔요. ② 친구가집에있어요.
Choose the correct spelling: ① (머거요 / 먹어요) ② (빵을 / 빵 을)
Put the words in the most natural order (the subject first, the verb last) and write the sentence with spaces: ① 마셔요 / 우유를 / 저는 ② 가요 / 시장에 / 엄마가
answers: ① 옷이 커요. ② 손을 씻어요. ③ 이름을 써요.
① 저는 커피를 마셔요. ② 친구가 집에 있어요.
① 저는 우유를 마셔요. ② 엄마가 시장에 가요.
